q: Who is this? This ghoul guards a bar in Underworld and can join the Lone Wanderer as a combat companion.
explanation: Charon is a ghoul residing in Underworld in the Capital Wasteland, working as the bouncer for the Ninth Circle bar run by Ahzrukhal in 2277.

q: What is Justin Ayo responsible for leading in Fallout 4?
explanation: Dr. Justin Ayo (username Ayo.J) is the acting director of the Synth Retention Bureau in 2287.

q: Who is this? This Institute official leads the bureau that coordinates coursers and synth infantry and oversees security and surface operations.
explanation: Head of the Synth Retention Bureau, Justin Ayo is essentially in charge of the Institute's security as well as its surface operations.

q: What group does Morpheus lead in Fallout?
explanation: Father Morpheus is the leader of the Children of the Cathedral, and the self-styled "master of Death" and "wielder of a black staff."

q: Who is this? He leads a religious movement that gathers information for a powerful ally and advances the Unity's cause.
explanation: Four years later, Morpheus and his people would form the core of the Children of the Cathedral, a religious movement spreading out across the wasteland, collecting information for Morpheus and the Master, and advancing…

q: What does Old Man Stockton manage in Fallout 4?
explanation: Stockton is the manager of a large caravan company operating out of Bunker Hill and is one of the owners of the town.

q: Who is this? This Bunker Hill owner runs a caravan company and secretly helps escaped synths as a Railroad operative.
explanation: In addition to being an operative for the Railroad, Stockton is also the caretaker for the large safehouse in the utility basement below Bunker Hill that is home to many escaped synths.

q: What do paladins lead in Fallout 3?
explanation: Paladins lead the squads of knights and go first into combat.

q: Who is this? These high-ranking Brotherhood fighters lead knight squads and are usually heavily armed.
explanation: Paladins lead the squads of knights and go first into combat. They are usually more heavily armed and may get even the most advanced of weapons.

q: What kind of gang does Sinjin lead in Fallout 4?
explanation: Sinjin is a ghoul who leads a raider gang that, by 2287, has been rapidly gaining power and influence in the Commonwealth.

q: Who is this? This ghoul united several smaller raider groups and gained influence around Goodneighbor in the Commonwealth.
explanation: Despite this reputation, Sinjin has been able to unite several smaller groups of raiders under his leadership alongside his right-hand woman Avery, with several lieutenants and associates including AJ, Wayne Delancy…

q: What do Enclave officers lead through the Capital Wasteland?
explanation: Enclave officers are encountered leading squads of Enclave soldiers through the Capital Wasteland in the year 2277.

q: Who is this? These commanders lead troops at outposts across the Capital Wasteland, but have less armor than their subordinates.
explanation: Enclave officers are often found commanding a group of Enclave soldiers at the many outposts established throughout the Capital Wasteland.

q: What is Mags Black known for leading in Nuka-World?
options: fighting to the death at the Nuka-World power plant
setting up shop in the Parlor
betraying the Sole Survivor in Power Play
explanation: Currently, Mags leads the raider gang the Operators in Nuka-World…

q: Who is this? This raider boss leads the Operators in Nuka-World and runs shop in the Parlor to make caps.
explanation: Currently, Mags leads the raider gang the Operators in Nuka-World, setting up shop in Nuka-World's former theater, the Parlor, with the sole intent of making as many caps as possible.

q: What does Penny Fitzgerald do during the Human Error investigation?
options: spend her lunch hour in the office
reveal the location of the Compound with Charisma
become hostile when the town's secret is uncovered
explanation: Like the other residents, Penny will play dumb during the investigation, and may become angered if the Sole Survivor persists.

q: Who is this? This merchant runs Covenant's main trading post and is the general merchant for most visitors.
explanation: Penny is the general merchant at Covenant and owns the primary trading post.

q: After the Vernon Square ambush, where was Reilly forced to take shelter?
explanation: where they were ambushed by the infesting super mutants and eventually overpowered, forced to take shelter in the Statesman Hotel.

q: Who is this? She founded a ranger mercenary group dedicated to eradicating super mutants and mapping the Capital Wasteland.
explanation: Four years prior to 2277, at the age of 26, she founded a group dedicated to eradicating the threat of super mutants and geomapping the Capital Wasteland, naming them Reilly's Rangers.

q: Where was Rose MacLean imprisoned?
options: Moldaver's headquarters at Griffith Observatory in Los Angeles
explanation: imprisoned in Moldaver's headquarters at Griffith Observatory in Los Angeles…

q: Who is this? This ghoul became a leader figure for NCR remnants and worked on getting cold fusion to restore the ruined city.
explanation: where the remnants of the NCR's armed forces rallied under her as the "Flame Mother" as she worked on her plan to acquire the Vault-Tec cold fusion device to bring power and life back to the ruined city.

q: In the Wang Dang Atomic Tango quest, what can Fisto be programmed as?
options: a companion from the game's later development
the robotic prostitute for James Garret
a Protectron security robot left on standby
explanation: Fisto is the only robot that can be programmed as the robotic prostitute needed to complete this quest for James Garret.

q: Who is this? This unique Protectron-class security robot is reprogrammable and was left on standby in Cerulean Robotics in Freeside.
explanation: The Fully Integrated Security Technetronic Officer, colloquially shortened to Fisto, is a reprogrammable Protectron left on standby in Cerulean Robotics in Freeside.

q: Where does Lucas Miller operate out of as a traveling caravan merchant?
explanation: Part of Old Man Stockton's caravan outfit, Lucas Miller is one of the traveling caravan merchants operating out of Bunker Hill.

q: Who is this? This traveling merchant runs routes out of Bunker Hill and sells armor and clothing to people in the Commonwealth.
explanation: Part of Old Man Stockton's caravan outfit, Lucas Miller is one of the traveling caravan merchants operating out of Bunker Hill.

q: What does Professor Scara do when visitors come to the Science! Center?
options: asks visitors to leave without answers
explanation: refusing to deal with visitors and referring them to Duff instead.

q: Who is this? This serious scientist in Diamond City refuses to deal with visitors and refers them to Doctor Duff instead.
explanation: a much more serious scientist, refusing to deal with visitors and referring them to Duff instead.

q: What does Proctor Quinlan try to identify among recovered material on the Prydwen?
explanation: trying to identify useful information among the sea of what he considers useless noise…

q: Who is this? This methodical Brotherhood officer sifts recovered material to find useful technical information and filters out noise.
explanation: His primary duty on board the Prydwen is sifting through the immense amount of material recovered from the region, trying to identify useful information among the sea of what he considers useless noise…

q: What place does Rufus Rubins ask the player to retrieve Drinkin' Buddy from?
options: the basement of the Shamrock Taphouse
explanation: Rufus will ask the Sole Survivor to retrieve a modified Protectron named Drinkin' Buddy from the basement of the Shamrock Taphouse and deliver it to Hotel Rexford.

q: Who is this? This handyman in Goodneighbor helps keep the town running by making sure local equipment stays in working order.
explanation: Rubins is the local handyman in Goodneighbor, helping to ensure the equipment keeping the town running remains in working order.

q: Where is Bosco's raider outfit based out of?
explanation: Bosco is a raider boss in charge of a large raider outfit based out of D.B. Technical High School that controls most of the other raider gangs around downtown Boston in 2287.

q: Who is this? This raider boss led his group from D.B. Technical High School and helped take over much of Boston's raider territory.
explanation: By 2287, he and his gang have assimilated many rival raider gangs into their outfit and have gained control over most of Boston's raider territory.

q: What does Fred Allen document about each chem he takes?
options: the amount of caps he offers
how to repair a broken terminal
explanation: Thus Allen documents the reaction to every chem he takes to improve his understanding of the high of each chem he sells.

q: Who is this? This chem dealer works for Marowski in Goodneighbor and experiments to understand how his drugs affect people.
explanation: When not peddling drugs for his boss Marowski, Fred likes to experiment with them.

q: In the Pitt in 2277, what is Midea known as?
options: the one who nominates you to fight in the Hole
the one who directs you to Wernher's hideout
the de-facto leader of the slaves
the one who offers shelter there
explanation: Midea is the de-facto leader of the slaves in the Pitt in 2277.

q: Who is this? She wants to free herself and her people from Ashur's rule and helps plan the theft of the cure.
explanation: Although she desires to free herself and her people from Ashur's rule by any means necessary, she has heard the frightening stories of what it was like in the city before he took over…

q: What UK-style trait is Whitechapel Charlie programmed to have?
options: the Union Jack stamped on his chassis
Cockney rhyming slang in his rewards quote
explanation: He is programmed to have an alternative Cockney accent, wears a bowler hat, and has the Union Jack, the national flag of the UK, stamped on his chassis.

q: Who is this? This unique Mister Handy manages the bar at the Third Rail in Goodneighbor and helps players with quests there.
explanation: A Mister Handy that manages the bar at the Third Rail, Goodneighbor's premier (and perhaps only genuine) watering hole, Whitechapel Charlie can be distinguished from other Handy units…

q: During the Great War, what did Edward Deegan help secure from looters?
options: a security team to protect Lorenzo Cabot
explanation: When the Great War began, Jack and Deegan secured the Parsons State Insane Asylum from looters…

q: Who is this? This Cabot aide is a bodyguard and head of security who acts as the family's messenger and righthand man.
explanation: He is charged with being the bodyguard, messenger, head of security and righthand man for the centuries-old family…

q: In 2296, what did the Lacerta Legate declare himself in the Mojave Wasteland?
explanation: after declaring himself the new Caesar in the Mojave Wasteland in 2296.

q: Who is this? He rises to lead Caesar's Legion and proclaims himself next Caesar after recovering Caesar's skeleton.
explanation: The former legate proclaims himself the next Caesar and that the Legion will reclaim New Vegas and build a palace worthy of their empire…

q: What does Lana Danvers do to people on the Rivet City Council if they have unsavory activities?
options: pass Doctor Li requests through Garza
check in on the night shift
explanation: If it becomes clear that anyone on or trying to be on the council has engaged in unsavory activities, she will make sure their political aspirations come to an end.

q: Who is this? This Rivet City security leader checks in with civilians and other officers during the night shift.
explanation: Danvers makes sure to check in with any civilians or other officers she encounters while commanding the night shift.

q: What is Tristan responsible for each day at the Citadel?
options: coordinating an assault on the Enclave relay station
explanation: Tristan is responsible for the daily operations of the Citadel and he helps assist Paladin Gunny with training new members.

q: Who is this? This operation specialist oversees the Citadel daily and helps train new Brotherhood members.
explanation: Tristan is responsible for the daily operations of the Citadel and he helps assist Paladin Gunny with training new members.

q: What does Jo run in Modoc?
options: the dead bodies at the Ghost Farm
explanation: Jo is the sheriff/mayor of Modoc in 2241 and runs its trading post.

q: Who is this? This Modoc official is the sheriff/mayor in 2241 and runs the town's trading post.
explanation: Jo is the sheriff/mayor of Modoc in 2241 and runs its trading post.

q: What does Minerva do that makes her a popular vendor in Appalachia?
options: sell gold bullion at a discount
protect her caravan on the move
explanation: She has one key advantage in her line of work: an exceptional memory and the capability to copy any schematic, plan or recipe she sees in perfect detail, not unlike a human copying machine.

q: Who is this? This gold bullion vendor sells discounted unique plans for purchase at a 25% discount.
explanation: In gameplay terms, she is a discounted gold bullion merchant, offering a selection of unique plans for purchase at a 25% discount.

q: Who targets Pickman for revenge in late 2287?
explanation: this eventually led to him being targeted for revenge by Slab's gang, who have cornered him inside his home in late 2287.

q: Who is this? This Boston gallery owner creates paintings using blood and viscera taken from raiders he kills.
explanation: A self-described artist, he creates his works using the unconventional painting material of blood and viscera harvested from the raiders he kills; this eventually led to him being targeted for revenge by Slab's gang…

q: What is Alexis Combes known for in Vault 81?
options: living as a ghoul in The Slog
being a runaway synth in the Commonwealth
explanation: Alexis is a vendor found in Vault 81; located in the depot in the first room on the right upon leaving the elevator.

q: Who is this? She sells items in a Vault 81 depot and works with her husband, Holt.
explanation: Alexis is a vendor found in Vault 81; located in the depot in the first room on the right upon leaving the elevator.

q: What is Amelia Stockton known for in Fallout 4?
options: being a runaway synth in the Commonwealth
living as a ghoul in The Slog
being the mother of the Chosen One
explanation: Amelia Stockton is a runaway synth living in the Commonwealth in 2287.

q: Where does Arlen Glass want the Sole Survivor to travel?
explanation: Arlen asks the Sole Survivor to travel to the Wilson Atomatoys factory and recover spare parts for a project he is working on.

q: Who is this? He co-founded Wilson Atomatoys and worked as the lead designer for toy products.
explanation: Co-founder of Wilson Atomatoys, Arlen was the lead toy designer until October 21, 2077.

q: Who is this? She leads her village and is the mother of the Chosen One, guiding major quests for survival.
explanation: The Arroyo elder is the leader of the village of Arroyo, the daughter of the Vault Dweller, and the mother of the Chosen One.

q: What is Birch known for in Oasis?
options: sending the Chosen One to get the GECK
running a vendor depot in Vault 81
leading the Treeminders as Tree Father
explanation: Tree Father Birch is the leader of the Treeminders in Oasis.

q: Who is this? This spiritual and temporal leader guides the cult's communion with Harold in Oasis.
explanation: While the village is ostensibly a democratic commune, Birch acts as the group's spiritual and temporal leader.

q: What are Enclave soldiers known for in Fallout 2?
options: being the toughest, strongest, and fastest
stationing in Navarro with combat armor
training on the Oil Rig with T-51b
explanation: Enclave soldiers are the main infantry of the Enclave's Department of the Army, and are the toughest, strongest and fastest human enemies that can be faced.

q: Who is this? This infantry is the main force of the Department of the Army and has professional training and communication in Fallout 2.
explanation: Enclave soldiers also benefit from professional military training and communication systems, due to them being the direct descendants of the United States Armed Forces.

q: What is Paladin Gunny tasked with teaching new initiates?
options: training all initiates in power armor
training the Lone Wanderer with permission
explanation: Paladin Gunny is a Brotherhood of Steel paladin stationed at the Citadel in 2277, and is tasked as the drill instructor for new initiates.

q: Who is this? A Brotherhood paladin at the Citadel serves as the drill instructor for new initiates and trains them before they are pressed into service.
explanation: Paladin Gunny is a Brotherhood of Steel paladin stationed at the Citadel in 2277, and is tasked as the drill instructor for new initiates.

q: What is Skinny Malone known for in Vault 114?
options: having a rivalry with Nick Valentine
imprisoning Nick Valentine in an office
leading the Triggermen at Park Street
explanation: Skinny Malone is the leader of the Triggermen group occupying Park Street station and Vault 114 connected to it beneath the Boston Common in 2287.

q: Who is this? This Triggermen leader occupies Park Street station and Vault 114 connected to it beneath the Boston Common in 2287.
explanation: Skinny Malone is the leader of the Triggermen group occupying Park Street station and Vault 114 connected to it beneath the Boston Common in 2287.

q: What does Wellingham do at the Colonial Taphouse in Diamond City?
options: acts as a secret informant for gossip
serves guests as a Mister Handy
sells flamer fuel, food and drinks
explanation: Wellingham is a Mister Handy that serves guests at the Colonial Taphouse at the Diamond City market in 2287.

q: Who is this? This Mister Handy serves guests at a Diamond City taphouse and secretly provides gossip to a detective.
explanation: Wellingham and Piper Wright have a unique dialogue together that reveals that he is secretly an informant for her, dishing out gossip about the city's upper-class members.

q: What is Nicole's vision for the Followers of the Apocalypse?
options: trusting the Children of the Cathedral
using a spy inside the Cathedral
explanation: Her vision is to restore peace to the world non-violently.

q: Who is this? This leader of the Followers wants peace without violence and distrusts the Cathedral group because they seem not to be genuine.
explanation: Nicole is described as the intelligent and good hearted leader of the Followers. Her vision is to restore peace to the world non-violently.

q: What is Solomon known for at the Diamond City market?
options: Leading a raider gang in the Commonwealth
Providing free clinic care for synths
Crafting power armor for the Atom Cats
explanation: Solomon is a drug vendor who runs the shop Chem-I-Care in the Diamond City market.

q: Who is this? A drug vendor runs the Chem-I-Care shop in the Diamond City market, supplying chems to visitors.
explanation: Solomon is a drug vendor who runs the shop Chem-I-Care in the Diamond City market.

q: What medical role does Dean Volkert have at the Institute?
options: Running the Hydroponics lab for Isaac Karlin
Training synth workers as a field medic
Maintaining medical records for the Minutemen
explanation: Doctor Dean Volkert (username Volkert.D) is a scientist in the BioScience division of the Institute as well as the chief medical specialist in their subterranean facility in the Commonwealth in 2287.

q: Who is this? This Institute physician runs medical care in a subterranean facility and keeps records so patients can keep advancing science.
explanation: Doctor Dean Volkert (username Volkert.D) is a scientist in the BioScience division of the Institute as well as the chief medical specialist in their subterranean facility in the Commonwealth in 2287.

q: What does Rowdy sell as an Atom Cats power-armor merchant?
options: Recruiting wasteland engineers for the Minutemen
Medical treatments for Institute cancer patients
Chemicals sold at Chem-I-Care in Diamond City
explanation: She sells the Atom Cats custom paint job schematic and stocks fusion cores, a power armor frame, and a full set of Atom Cats painted T-60.

q: Who is this? A former raider taken in by the Atom Cats became their power-armor specialist merchant and sells armor supplies.
explanation: Rowdy used to be a raider in the Commonwealth, but she was left for dead by her comrades during a raid. She was then found by the Atom Cats, who took her in as another member of the gang.

q: What happens to T.S. Wallace after the Institute notices him?
options: They enlist him to join the Atom Cats
They hire him to run Chem-I-Care in Diamond City
They observe him for possible recruitment
They send him to fight in the Capital Wasteland
explanation: Gifted with an exceptional intellect, Wallace is being observed by the Institute for possible recruitment.

q: Who is this? This self-taught engineer studied pre-War technology and radiation effects, drawing the Institute's attention for recruitment.
explanation: A self-taught engineer and scientist, Wallace has spent years studying whatever pre-War technology he could find, as well as the effects of radiation and chems on human biology.

q: What sales pitch did AJ start for young children in 2287?
options: a bottlecap bribe to the Silver Shroud
explanation: Recently, he has started a new "Chems for Kids" sales pitch directed towards young children, with some success.

q: Who is this? This drug dealer in Goodneighbor runs Sinjin's gang and tries to sell chems to children with a "Chems for Kids" pitch.
explanation: Recently, he has started a new "Chems for Kids" sales pitch directed towards young children, with some success.

q: Where is Arkansas based in the Capital Wasteland?
explanation: Arkansas is a sniper residing in Minefield in the Capital Wasteland.

q: Who is this? This sniper in the Wasteland set traps and attacked slavers so the town would not be raided again.
explanation: Swearing revenge on the slavers, Arkansas began spreading rumors that the town had been repopulated in hopes of luring the slavers that took his tribe back, this time into a trap set by him.

q: What was Bowditch the mastermind behind creating from the ruins of the Pentagon?
explanation: He was the mastermind behind the establishment of the Citadel out of the ruins of the Pentagon, complete with its crane-operated outer gate.

q: Who is this? This Brotherhood proctor maintains defenses and runs the smithy in the Citadel, focusing most of his time on power armor.
explanation: Scribe Bowditch is the proctor of the Order of the Shield and head of the Brotherhood of Steel's smithy in the Citadel.

q: What did Curie III oversee for the Apostles of the Eternal Light?
options: teaching that salvation comes through radiation
the irradiation of the holy water
refusing to respond to violence with violence
explanation: Curie quickly set to work overseeing irradiation of the holy water, which has kept her inside the monastery ever since…

q: Who is this? This Atom church founder leads the Apostles of the Eternal Light and pushes her group toward "Enlightenment" through radiation.
explanation: Mother Curie III, or Curie the Third, is a member of the Church of the Children of Atom and the founder and leader of the Apostles of the Eternal Light.

q: What does Nadine provide to help the Lone Wanderer find Jackson?
options: information on where he is hiding
free ship rides on the Duchess Gambit
explanation: Nadine provides the key to finding Jackson and removes the Lone Wanderer's scar (which restores their hair and lets them wear hats again) after Walking with Spirits is completed.

q: Who is this? This Point Lookout explorer joins Jackson's tribal group, helps the player with key quest info, and later gains control of a ship for free travel.
explanation: Her explorations there led to Nadine joining Jackson's group of tribals at the Ark & Dove Cathedral, also resulting in her imbibing the Mother Punga and Tobar surgically removing a lump of brain from her.

q: What is Doctor Sun known for providing in Diamond City?
explanation: Sun is a very accomplished doctor who provides medical treatment such as purging radiation, restoring health, and addiction rehabilitation.

q: Who is this? A skilled doctor in Diamond City offers medical treatment and can perform facial reconstruction surgery near the market.
explanation: Sun also sells medical supplies and can provide facial reconstruction surgery in place of Doc Crocker for 100 caps, but considers it to not be real medicine.

q: What does ZAX 1.2 control at the Glow?
explanation: ZAX 1.2 is the supercomputer machine intelligence controlling the facility at the Glow since 2055.

q: Who is this? An advanced intelligence was brought in to regulate conditions at the West Tek research facility and support research efforts.
explanation: In 2055, ZAX was brought in to regulate conditions in the West Tek research facility.

q: What does Bullet offer to do when the Sole Survivor meets him?
options: demand the child and his parents
explanation: Kid in a Fridge: The Sole Survivor encounters Bullet who offers to buy Billy.

q: Who is this? A high-ranking Gunner from Quincy leads a small team and is willing to use people for his needs.
explanation: Not much is known about Bullet, apart from the fact he seems to be a high-ranking member of the Gunners, who leads a small team.

q: What does Carol take care of at her place in Underworld?
explanation: She takes care of the rooms, while Greta focuses on cuisine The two also "adopted" a younger ghoul, Gob, who was like a son to Carol.

q: Who is this? This ghoul owner in Underworld runs a bed-and-breakfast and believes the settlement gives ghouls a better life among themselves.
explanation: She believes that Underworld is a chance for ghouls to live as people, among their own, rather than suffer indignities as monsters to the wasteland at large.

q: What does Ellie Perkins handle for Nick Valentine at the office?
explanation: As such, she handles his appointments, papers, and even the consoling of distraught clients.

q: Who is this? A secretary for a private detective in Diamond City manages appointments, paperwork, and comforts distraught clients.
explanation: Ellie Perkins is the secretary of private investigator Nick Valentine, operating out of the Valentine Detective Agency located in Diamond City in 2287.

q: What did Monty do to infiltrate Vault 33?
options: posed as a New Vegas trader
explanation: He posed as a Vault 32 resident and was the "breeder" in the Vaults' Triennial Trade in 2296.

q: Who is this? This raider infiltrated a vault by posing as a resident and was exchanged in a trade between vaults.
explanation: He posed as a Vault 32 resident and was the "breeder" in the Vaults' Triennial Trade in 2296.

q: Where were the NCR soldiers stationed after Shady Sands was destroyed?
explanation: these members of the New California Republic Army were stationed at Griffith Observatory before they were wiped out by the Brotherhood of Steel.

q: What does Paulie Cantelli do with his wife in Rivet City?
options: run the A Quick Fix chem dispensary
explanation: Paulie and his wife Cindy run A Quick Fix, the chem dispensary in the Rivet City market.

q: Who is this? This chem addict helps run a dispensary in Rivet City with his wife, though he often steals from the shop.
explanation: Paulie and his wife Cindy run A Quick Fix, the chem dispensary in the Rivet City market.

q: What did Captain Zao fire on the day of the Great War?
options: a distress signal to the Brotherhood
explanation: Zao recalls firing his ship's nuclear salvo as ordered on October 23, 2077, the day of the Great War…

q: Who is this? This former Chinese naval officer commands a submarine and feels guilty about the nuclear destruction he caused.
explanation: Captain Zao is the ghoulified captain of the Yangtze-31 and a former officer of the pre-War Chinese Navy.

q: What is Knight-Captain Cade responsible for aboard the Prydwen?
options: training new recruits in power armor
administering medical exams to new recruits
teaching new recruits how to repair weapons
explanation: He is in charge of administering medical exams to new recruits of the Brotherhood of Steel.

q: Who is this? This Brotherhood medical officer examines new recruits and monitors soldiers who may be mentally distressed after missions.
explanation: He is in charge of administering medical exams to new recruits of the Brotherhood of Steel.

q: What did the humanoid robots do in Fallout Tactics?
options: served as the Calculator's main combat unit
founded a safe haven for ghouls
guarded the entrance to Diamond City
explanation: The humanoid robots were the main combat unit of the Calculator's army.

q: What were the Vault 31 dwellers preserved for in Vault 31?
options: to guard the entrance to Diamond City
to become overseers of Vaults 32 and 33
to farm tarberries in the Commonwealth
explanation: The Buds would find a way to become the overseers of Vaults 32 and 33 and use their positions to indoctrinate their dwellers into model Vault-Tec citizens.

q: Who is this? These pre-War Vault-Tec trainees were frozen and later sent to lead neighboring vaults as overseers.
explanation: Vault 31 contained only cryostasis chambers where members of Bud's Buds would be preserved…

q: What did Wiseman establish in Fallout 4?
options: a security post at Diamond City
a safe haven for persecuted ghouls
a management program for Vault-Tec trainees
explanation: Intending the establishment to be a safe haven for persecuted ghouls, it eventually grew into a tarberry farm - one of the sole producers of the fruit in the Commonwealth.

q: Who is this? After leaving Diamond City, this friendly ghoul founded a settlement in an old swimming pool that became a tarberry farm.
explanation: he instead founded "the Slog" within an old public swimming pool.

q: What does Doc Church do in Megaton in Fallout 3?
explanation: As Megaton's only doctor, he has got a lot on his plate and does not appreciate people bothering him without good cause.

q: Who is this? This overworked professional treats the residents of Megaton and can be found at its clinic during the day.
explanation: Doc Church can be found at the Megaton clinic at any given time during the day.

q: What was Danny Sullivan responsible for at Diamond City in Fallout 4?
options: founding a ghoul settlement and tarberry farm
treating patients at the Megaton clinic
explanation: Danny is the Diamond City security officer responsible for monitoring the main entrance to the city for potential threats and troublemakers.

q: Who is this? This security officer watches Diamond City's gate and is ordered to keep a reporter out of the city.
explanation: Under the orders of Mayor McDonough, Danny is reluctantly denying Piper access to the city.

q: What does Drummer Boy do for the Railroad in Fallout 4?
options: Serves as the primary courier for HQ
explanation: Drummer Boy is a member of the Railroad operating in the Commonwealth in 2287, working as the primary courier for the Railroad HQ and liaison to their field agents.

q: Who is this? This Railroad member carries messages for HQ and connects field agents with orders from its high-level members.
explanation: In the modern incarnation of the Railroad, he is the liaison who connects field agents with the orders given by the high-level members in the Railroad HQ,…

q: What is Durga's role at the Citadel in Fallout 3?
options: She leads the Brotherhood's field operations
She trains new recruits in the Brotherhood
She serves as the Brotherhood of Steel quartermaster
explanation: Knight Captain Durga is the Brotherhood of Steel quartermaster based out of the Citadel in 2277.

q: Who is this? This Brotherhood officer manages the Citadel armory but would rather take part in field operations.
explanation: Instead, her preferences lie outside the Citadel, where she would rather be engaged in field operations and using the armory's weapons, not polishing and cataloging them as she does now.

q: What kind of support can Ricky Dalton provide during the Railroad's Tradecraft quest?
explanation: If the Sole Survivor joins the Railroad and accepts the quest Tradecraft, Ricky can be convinced to cause a distraction (resulting in his death), or provide sniper support.

q: Who is this? This Railroad informant watches a former headquarters near Lexington and can help with a mission by providing sniper support.
explanation: Recently, Ricky has been trailing the elevated highway west of the city of Lexington, monitoring the local Slocum's Joe coffee shop through a pair of binoculars.

q: What does Sonora Cruz do for the Regulators in Fallout 3?
options: Runs a caravan and sells supplies
Leads the group and pays bounty rewards
Trains the Enclave's soldiers and recruits
Leads the Brotherhood of Steel and assigns patrols
explanation: Sonora Cruz is the leader of the Regulators in the Capital Wasteland in 2277, directing their operators and paying bounty rewards at the group's headquarters north of the Washington, D.C. ruins.

q: Who is this? This leader rewards members who bring proof that they have dealt with unjust people in the Capital Wasteland.
explanation: She has taken on the task of paying the organization's members for dispatching unjust individuals, for which the fingers of the unjust are used as evidence of the deed.

q: What does Toshiro Kago do after being thawed aboard Mothership Zeta?
options: Leads the Brotherhood's assault on the Citadel
Joins the counterattack against the Zetans
Helps the Zetans capture the Lone Wanderer
explanation: He joins them in their counterattack against the Zetans, seeking to reclaim his lost weapon in the process.

q: Who is this? This samurai was abducted from Japan and joins a fight against the aliens who froze him aboard their ship.
explanation: Toshiro was abducted from Japan by the Zetans sometime during the Azuchi-Momoyama period, between the late 1560s to early 1600s, and was then cryogenically frozen by them aboard Mothership Zeta.

q: What did Barney Rook set up around Salem in Fallout 4?
explanation: Barney made up for it by setting up a series of turrets around Salem at strategic locations, allowing him to remain posted on the roof of his home.

q: Who is this? This older resident defended Salem by placing turrets around town and serving as the militia's commander and quartermaster.
explanation: Along with being the commander, quartermaster, sergeant at arms, and scribe of the Salem Volunteer Militia,…

q: Which mercenary group does Commander Jabsco lead in Fallout 3?
explanation: Commander Jabsco is the leader of the Talon Company, and the only member of the organization not to wear its trademark armor.

q: Who is this? This commander plans mercenary operations from a bunker and leads Talon Company from Fort Bannister.
explanation: Jabsco is the brains of Talon Company, planning mercenary operations from the safety of his bunker within Fort Bannister.

q: What does Kessler oversee at Bunker Hill in Fallout 4?
explanation: Kessler oversees the caravans and merchants of Bunker Hill and ensures that trade can continue to flow through the settlement.

q: Who is this? This mayor keeps trade moving at Bunker Hill and negotiates with raiders to protect the merchant settlement.
explanation: Kessler convinced the raider gangs in the area that allowing the merchant settlement to operate was more profitable than the loot from a single raid.

q: What does Mandy Stiles want to do with the USS Constitution in Fallout 4?
options: Use it as a trading base
explanation: Mandy is intent on taking the ship along with Davies to salvage it for parts, which would keep herself and the crew from scrounging in the gutters again.

q: Who is this? This scavenger speaks for her group and wants to take apart a ship for parts to improve their lives.
explanation: Mandy acts the spokesperson for the group when dealing with the Sole Survivor…

q: What did Scribe Peabody help repair for the Brotherhood in Fallout 3?
explanation: and has previously used his expertise in helping repair Liberty Prime's weapon systems.

q: Who is this? This Brotherhood weapons expert maintains the armory and adapts its weapons to fight the Enclave.
explanation: As proctor of the Order of the Sword, Peabody is head of the armory, in charge of maintaining, researching and developing all of the chapter's various weapons and their systems.

q: What does Sheng Kawolski manage in Diamond City in Fallout 4?
explanation: Sheng Kawolski is a young boy who is in charge of the water purifier in Diamond City in 2287.

q: Who is this? This young Diamond City resident manages the water purifier by day and attends night classes at the schoolhouse.
explanation: During the day Sheng is in charge of Diamond City's water purifying system. At night he goes to the schoolhouse and sits at a desk to take night classes.

q: What is Wayne Delancy known for in Goodneighbor in Fallout 4?
options: Running a bar for local residents
Murdering a woman and her child for their money
Repairing weapons for the town's guards
explanation: He became infamous in Goodneighbor for murdering a woman named Miss Selmy and her child for their money; his only thought on the matter is that it was a waste of time, as Selmy and her child barely had any caps for him…

q: Who is this? This Goodneighbor hitman works for a gang leader and became infamous for killing a woman and her child for their caps.
explanation: Wayne Delancy is a hitman living in Goodneighbor who works for the Sinjin as one of his "favorite toy soldiers" and one of the gang's most dangerous members.

q: What role does Zeke have among the squatters above Vault 15 in Fallout 2?
explanation: He is the leader of the squatters above Vault 15.

q: Who is this? This older squatter leads the group above Vault 15 and can be persuaded to accept the NCR's presence.
explanation: By just talking to Zeke, he can be convinced to accept the NCR's presence in the region.

q: What does AHS-7 do for newcomers at the Hubologists' base in Fallout 2?
options: Assigns them jobs in the tanker
Teaches them to fight the Shi
explanation: He serves as the representative to San Francisco's Hubologist base and introduces newcomers into the cult.

q: Who is this? This Hubologist representative introduces newcomers to the cult and can perform the scan needed to join it.
explanation: He serves as the representative to San Francisco's Hubologist base and introduces newcomers into the cult. Similar to the Enlightened One, he is able to perform a zeta scan, which is necessary to join their sect.

q: What position does Sergeant Baker hold among the Gunners at Quincy in Fallout 4?
explanation: Sergeant Baker is one of the residing Gunner leaders at the Quincy ruins.

q: Who is this? This Gunner leader keeps watch over Quincy from a post in the old church's bell tower.
explanation: Baker has a watch post set up in the church's bell tower, where he stands watch over the town.

q: What is Bob (tree) known for in the Fallout series?
options: guarding the city of New Reno
forming the forest of Oasis with Harold
building a settlement in the Mojave
explanation: Harold and Bob's living body became a small forest called Oasis, where they are worshipped by the Treeminders.

q: Who is this? This parasitic tree overtook a mutant's body and helped form a forest where a group of people worships them.
explanation: Within another century, Bob overtook Harold's body entirely, and rooted him to the ground.

q: What do Buck Dunton and his twin make in Klamath?
options: healing salves made from desert plants
meat jerky made from old, rotten meat
explanation: They are the makers of their "world famous" Dunton meat jerky, made from old, rotten meat, flavored with spices, homemade sauce and choice boot scrapings from the pen.

q: Who is this? This Klamath shopkeeper makes jerky with his twin and steals brahmin from local farmers.
explanation: Their livelihood, though, are brahmin, or rather, stealing brahmin from farmers in the area, typically Torr Buckner.

q: What do Chuck Dunton and his twin make in Klamath?
options: healing salves made from desert plants
meat jerky made from old, rotten meat
explanation: They are the makers of their "world famous" Dunton meat jerky, made from old, rotten meat, flavored with spices, homemade sauce and choice boot scrapings from the pen.

q: Who is this? This Klamath shopkeeper makes jerky with his twin and steals brahmin from local farmers.
explanation: Their livelihood, though, are brahmin, or rather, stealing brahmin from farmers in the area, typically Torr Buckner.

q: What job does Duppo offer people willing to work hard?
options: work in the brahmin driving business
repair weapons for the NCR army
explanation: Duppo has a friendly demeanor, and will offer a job to anyone willing to work hard in the brahmin driving business.

q: Who is this? This NCR resident runs the biggest downtown shop and leads the Stockmen's Association.
explanation: Apart from running the biggest shop downtown, he is also head of the Stockmen's Association.

q: What is Fahrenheit's role in Goodneighbor?
explanation: Fahrenheit is a prominent figure of Goodneighbor who serves as Hancock's personal bodyguard.

q: Who is this? This Goodneighbor resident protects its mayor and can confront a group trying to break into his storehouse.
explanation: John Hancock sends his bodyguard Fahrenheit and a few members of the Triggermen to intercept the group.

q: What does Marge LeBarge own in Redding?
explanation: Marge LeBarge is the owner of the Kokoweef Mine in 2241.

q: Who is this? This mine owner competes with other local leaders and believes Redding should join the NCR.
explanation: Marge firmly believes that throwing Redding's lot with the anarchic, violent city of sin would backfire.

q: What does Phyllis do in Vault City?
explanation: Phyllis (born 2216) is the resident medical assistant of Vault City, working under Dr. Troy in 2241.

q: Who is this? This nurse works with a doctor to keep Vault City residents healthy and is curious about the outside world.
explanation: She is a competent nurse, working with Dr. Troy in Vault 8 to keep the citizens in good health.

q: What kind of technology does Rosalind Orman focus on developing?
options: High-energy weapons such as plasma weapons
explanation: One of her main areas of interest is the development of high-energy weaponry such as plasma weapons.

q: Who is this? This Institute scientist is a workaholic who designs new technology, especially powerful energy weapons.
explanation: Nothing excites her more than research, and if she could, she would spend her whole day doing nothing but designing new technologies.

q: Who is this? This New Reno boxing manager spots promising young fighters and gets them to compete for him.
explanation: He has a knack for spotting fledgling talent and coercing people into fighting for him.

q: What kind of attacks does Tessa prefer in combat?
explanation: She wears low-end power armor and prefers melee attacks over firearms.

q: Who is this? This former raider serves with the Gunners and distrusts their leader in Quincy.
explanation: A former raider, Tessa does not trust Clint, the overall leader of the Quincy Gunners, and has feelings for Baker, the other commander.

q: What does Abbot maintain in Fallout 4's Diamond City?
explanation: Abbot is the caretaker of the wall in Diamond City in 2287.

q: Who is this? This Diamond City resident maintains the settlement's wall and asks the Sole Survivor to find green paint for it.
explanation: Abbot is one of the oldest citizens of Diamond City, whose main role is maintaining its wall.

q: What role does Benjamin hold in Vault 4 in the Fallout TV series?
explanation: Overseer Benjamin, or Ben, is the overseer of Vault 4 in 2296.

q: Who is this? This Vault 4 ruler sentences Lucy to exile on the surface and gives her two weeks of survival supplies.
explanation: Later, Ben sentences Lucy to death by exile and gives her two weeks of survival supplies.

q: What weapons are Enclave Hellfire troopers known for using in Fallout 3?
explanation: Enclave Hellfire troopers are easily identifiable by their unique namesake power armor and signature flamethrower weapons.

q: What does Irving Gallows do during the battle toward Project Purity in Fallout 3?
options: assists the player and Liberty Prime
guards the entrance to the Citadel
explanation: Gallows assists the player and Liberty Prime in the battle towards Project Purity.

q: Who is this? This Brotherhood soldier is an elite member of Lyons' Pride and helps fight toward Project Purity.
explanation: Knight Captain Gallows is an elite member of Lyons' Pride of the Brotherhood of Steel, found at the Citadel.

q: What do Brotherhood of Steel paladins regularly do around Lost Hills?
explanation: The paladins are regularly patrolling the perimeter of Lost Hills, they discourage unwanted elements from proceeding deeper into their territory.

q: Who is this? These Brotherhood soldiers patrol Lost Hills and protect its territory from unwanted visitors.
explanation: The paladins are regularly patrolling the perimeter of Lost Hills, they discourage unwanted elements from proceeding deeper into their territory.

q: What does Sajag own in Klamath?
explanation: Sajag is the owner of the Golden Gecko bar in Klamath in 2241.

q: Who is this? This persuasive trader runs a bar in Klamath and uses contacts in the Den to offer many goods.
explanation: Sajag is the owner of the Golden Gecko bar in Klamath in 2241.

q: Where does Shelly Tiller hide in the Commonwealth?
options: At the National Guard training yard
explanation: Seemingly aware of the trouble coming her way, Tiller went into hiding at the National Guard training yard, highly suspicious that someone would track her down in due time.

q: Who is this? This wastelander hides at a Commonwealth training yard after someone puts out an assassination contract on her.
explanation: Shelly Tiller is a wastelander sheltering at the National Guard training yard in the Commonwealth in 2287.

q: What facility did Tommy Whispers first discover for the Railroad?
explanation: In 2281, Tommy was the one who first discovered the Switchboard, a pre-War Defense Intelligence Agency facility hidden beneath a Slocum's Joe in Lexington.

q: Who is this? This Railroad scout discovered a hidden facility in Lexington that later became the group's headquarters.
explanation: The Railroad would subsequently claim the facility as their new headquarters.

q: What was Wan Yang's role before her capture?
explanation: Wan Yang (Chinese: 万洋, Wàn Yáng; whose aliases include: Jamie Patrick, Maria Lopez, Stanley Derrick and Five-Claw-Dragon) was a Chinese spy operating in the United States until her capture and transport to Point…

q: Who is this? This Chinese agent was arrested during an investigation into sabotage and later held at a detention camp.
explanation: Wan Yang first became known to the United States government when she was investigated and subsequently arrested as a suspect during the investigation of the Niagara Sabotage in 2062.

q: What does Anna Winslow need returned so she can leave the world?
explanation: - Return Anna's locket: Someone took her locket and she needs it back to leave this world.

q: Who is this? This ghost is trapped in the Den until the locket stolen from her family home is returned.
explanation: After the family passed away, including Anna, her spirit became trapped in the earthly realm, since Joey stole her locket from her family house, dooming her to eternal suffering.

q: What does Dorothy oversee in the town of the New California Republic?
explanation: Her role is to oversee the town's power plant and although somewhat skilled, she is by no means a genius at repairing broken electronic or mechanical equipment…

q: Who is this? This city engineer oversees a power plant and is often accompanied by a helpful robot named Toto.
explanation: Her role is to oversee the town's power plant and although somewhat skilled, she is by no means a genius at repairing broken electronic or mechanical equipment…

q: What kind of work reference can Dumont give the Chosen One?
options: a reference to work for the NCR Rangers
a reference to work for Duppo
a reference to work for Roger Westin
a reference to work for President Tandi
explanation: Dumont can give the Chosen One a reference to work for Roger Westin.

q: Who is this? This no-nonsense police chief keeps the peace in an NCR town and can recommend work for a local rancher.
explanation: Dumont is the head of the police in NCR town in 2241.

q: What does Doctor Duff teach visitors at the Science! Center?
explanation: After speaking to her about a free biology lesson, she will give the unmarked quest to find a bloatfly gland as part of a field trip.

q: Who is this? This friendly scientist welcomes visitors at the Science! Center and shares her knowledge of biology with them.
explanation: She's a treasure trove of knowledge, particularly relating to biology, and doesn't shy away from sharing it with anyone willing to listen.

q: Which town does Earl Marion serve as sheriff?
explanation: Earl Marion is the sheriff of the mining town of Redding in 2241.

q: Who is this? This sheriff of a mining town supports the NCR and relies on outside help after an accident leaves him with a crippled leg.
explanation: Around 2241, he got into a nasty accident and ended up with a crippled leg. Unable to perform his duties, he had to rely on external help - something the Chosen One could do.

q: What was the Enlightened One sent to Shady Sands to do?
options: recruit citizens for the NCR army
spread the word of her religion
deliver supplies to the town's power plant
explanation: A striking woman in a long robe with a fixed stare and expression of mindless bliss, the Enlightened One was sent by AHS-9 to Shady Sands to spread the word of their religion.

q: Who is this? This missionary travels to Shady Sands to promote her faith, though she has trouble converting the NCR's citizens.
explanation: However, she has found it hard to convert citizens of the NCR to her religion.

q: Who is this? This Vault 81 school student is best friends with Austin and owns a pet cat that escapes when the Sole Survivor arrives.
explanation: She attends the Vault's school and is best friends with Austin Engill. They often spend time together…

q: What does the first mate lead aboard the USS Constitution in Fallout 4?
explanation: leading the other Protectrons and turrets found on the ship.

q: Who is this? This Protectron serves aboard the USS Constitution and leads the other robots and turrets found on the ship.
explanation: leading the other Protectrons and turrets found on the ship.

q: What does Irma manage in Goodneighbor?
explanation: Irma manages the Memory Den with the help of her business partner Doctor Amari…

q: Who is this? This Goodneighbor business owner runs a place where clients can use memory loungers, with help from a doctor.
explanation: Irma manages the Memory Den with the help of her business partner Doctor Amari, the latter responsible for running the memory loungers…

q: What role does Mother Isolde have among the Children of Atom near the Commonwealth?
options: Spiritual leader of a peaceful sect
Military commander of a raider gang
explanation: Mother Isolde is the spiritual leader of a peaceful sect of the Children of Atom living near the Commonwealth in the late 2280s.

q: Who is this? This leader guides a peaceful Children of Atom community in the Glowing Sea and shares information about a nearby scientist.
explanation: Mother Isolde is the spiritual leader of a peaceful sect of the Children of Atom living near the Commonwealth…

q: What does Mom ask the Chosen One to do in Fallout 2?
explanation: Mom is too busy so she asks the Chosen One to bring Smitty his meal.

q: Who is this? This kindly diner owner in the Den is often cooking and cleaning, and asks for help delivering a meal to Smitty.
explanation: Mom is usually found cooking and cleaning her small diner in the East Side of the Den…

q: What does Percy Crump own in Gecko?
explanation: Percy Crump is a successful ghoul merchant who owns the Survival Gear Locker, a store in Gecko.

q: Who is this? This ghoul merchant owns a store in Gecko and values his friends, especially one who has gone missing.
explanation: He places very high value on his friends, especially Woody.

q: What does Torr Buckner guard in Klamath?
explanation: His family uses him for all sorts of menial work, including guarding their brahmin, or "moo-moos" as Torr calls them.

q: Who is this? This strong resident of Klamath is used by his family for menial work, including watching over their cattle.
explanation: Uncannily strong, his family uses him for all sorts of menial work, including guarding their brahmin, or "moo-moos" as Torr calls them.

q: What does Lydia run in downtown Vault City?
explanation: Lydia is the owner and proprietor of the Tap House in downtown Vault City in 2241.

q: Who is this? This Vault City bar owner serves visitors and is willing to pay someone to smuggle alcohol into the city.
explanation: As such, she is ready to pay anyone a handy sum if they smuggle in two crates of alcohol into the city and stay quiet about it.

q: What did the raiders do after their main leaders were defeated in Fallout Tactics?
explanation: However, they have joined the Brotherhood after the main leaders were defeated by the squad led by the Warrior.

q: What role does Zaius have at the Broken Hills uranium mine?
explanation: Zaius is a resident of Broken Hills, serving as the foreman of the uranium mine.

q: Who is this? This tough super mutant has worked in the Broken Hills mine since the settlement was founded.
explanation: A tough old super mutant, Zaius has worked in the uranium mines since Broken Hills itself was founded.

q: What did Zeke do in Fallout 4?
explanation: Zeke is the founder of the Atom Cats living in the Commonwealth in 2287.

q: Who is this? This person recruited members of the Atom Cats, most of whom came from troubled backgrounds, and helped them reform.
explanation: Zeke began recruiting the current members of the Atom Cats, most of whom came from troubled backgrounds, that he helped with reforming by "[showing] them the way of cool."

q: What was Festus' role in Gecko?
explanation: Festus is a particularly unkempt ghoul who lives in Gecko, where he serves as the manager of Gecko's nuclear power plant.

q: Who is this? This person was a plant technician with a massively inflated ego, capable of rudimentary speech but not very intelligent.
explanation: Festus is a glum looking ghoul with a particularly rancid appearance, who smells like an infected wound. Opinions of Festus differ from one person to the next.

q: Who is this? This person was a large albino mole-rat with an enlarged braincase, permanently frothing at the mouth, and rabidly hostile to humans.
explanation: A large albino mole-rat with an enlarged braincase, Keeng is permanently frothing at the mouth. He is the "leader" of the swarm of rats that has infested Klamath's trapper town.

q: What was Vortis' business in NCR Town?
explanation: Vortis is a slaver living in the bazaar of NCR Town in 2241. He exploits a legal loophole, since the bazaar is technically not NCR territory.

q: Who is this? This person exploited a legal loophole to hold slaves outside the NCR territory, using his knowledge of NCR laws to establish a business.
explanation: He knows the NCR laws well, better than most of its citizens, and used that knowledge to establish a business for slave owners: Since the Republic has outlawed slavery in its territories, he set up a holding center…

q: Who is this? These people were members of Caesar's Legion, appearing in the TV series Fallout.
explanation: The legionaries are members of Caesar's Legion who appear.

q: What did Louise do in Redding?
explanation: Louise is the owner of the Malamute Saloon in 2241.

q: Who is this? This elderly woman runs a saloon in Redding, offering food, shelter, and services, but refuses service to mutants and deadweight.
explanation: The owner of Redding's premier saloon is an elderly, tired woman, whose beauty is long past, but not entirely gone.

q: What did Mira run in Redding?
explanation: Mira is the bartender of the Rawhide Saloon in 2241.

q: Who is this? This young woman runs a tough saloon in Redding, refusing service to mutants and other oddities, and has a quest for the player to take care of her ex-husband.
explanation: Mira is a young, attractive green-haired woman with a scowl on her face, taking crap from no one, emphasized by the spiked knuckles hanging on her neck. She runs the Rawhide Saloon, a tough place for tough customers.

q: What did Skeev do in Vault City?
explanation: A scrawny young man with darting eyes, Skeev is Wallace's assistant at the Vault City customs office.

q: Who is this? This young man assists Wallace at Vault City's customs office, selling false citizenship papers and sometimes delivering poor wastelanders to Barkus for a finder's fee.
explanation: A scrawny young man with darting eyes, Skeev is Wallace's assistant at the Vault City customs office.

q: What did Cornelius lose in Modoc?
explanation: Cornelius has lost his gold pocket watch.

q: Who is this? This old man runs a bed and breakfast in Modoc with his wife Rose, and claims his best friend Farrel stole his pocket watch, which he asks the player to retrieve.
explanation: Cornelius is the old man who helps run Rose's Bed and Breakfast in Modoc in 2241. He seems to have a form of senile dementia, and it is hard to obtain any information from him as 'certain phrases seem to set him off.'

q: What did Happy Harry run in Vault City?
options: The main shop in the courtyard
explanation: Happy Harry is a short, jovial man who runs the main shop in Vault City's courtyard, named after himself.

q: Who is this? This short, jovial man runs the main shop in Vault City's courtyard, selling weapons, armor, and other necessities for the city's outsiders, and has a quest for the player to get a plow for Mr. Smith.
explanation: Happy Harry is a short, jovial man who runs the main shop in Vault City's courtyard, named after himself. He always seems to be very happy for some reason.

q: What did Phil (Khans) do in Fallout 2?
explanation: Phil is one of the New Khans who kidnapped Chrissy outside Vault 15 in order to have "fun" with her.

q: Who is this? This raider kidnapped a Vault dweller for fun.
explanation: Phil is one of the New Khans who kidnapped Chrissy outside Vault 15 in order to have "fun" with her.

q: Who is this? This cyberdog was activated for the Chosen One as payment for assisting Dr. Henry.
explanation: As payment for assisting him with field work for the mutagenic serum as part of a quest, Henry activates the cyberdog for the Chosen One.

q: What is Big Nose Sally Dunton known for in Fallout 2?
explanation: Big Nose Sally is the mother of the Dunton brothers, Buck and Chuck, running the Klamath bathhouse.

q: Who is this? This woman runs a bathhouse and takes care of its workers.
explanation: Big Nose Sally is the mother of the Dunton brothers, Buck and Chuck, running the Klamath bathhouse.

q: What is Wallace known for in Fallout 2?
options: Being the Customs Official of Vault City
explanation: Wallace is the Customs Official of Vault City in 2241.

q: Who is this? This official processes all merchants coming into the city and supervises transactions.
explanation: Wallace is a distinguished official in charge of processing all merchants coming into the city, supervising transactions, logging caravans, and issuing day passes to visitors.

q: What is Chip known for in Fallout 2?
explanation: Chip is a bald, generally likeable fellow who lives on the PMV Valdez among other vagrants of his kind in San Francisco in 2241.

q: Who is this? This sociable fellow likes drinking and gambling, often getting drunk and betting his spleen.
explanation: He is very sociable and likes drinking and gambling, to the point of getting drunk and betting his spleen in a game with Lao Chou, who promptly took his winnings and sold them to Dr. Wong Yi Tze.

q: What does Dan McGrew own in Redding?
explanation: "Dangerous" Dan McGrew is the owner of Redding's Morningstar Mine in 2241.

q: Who is this? This miner owns the Morningstar Mine and hopes to bring Redding under New Reno's protection.
explanation: He is the direct rival of Marge LeBarge and Doc Johnson, trying to align Redding with New Reno using the profits he makes from his mine.

q: What does Frankie run in the Den?
options: The Hole on the East Side
explanation: Frankie is the proprietor of The Hole in the Den East Side in 2241.

q: Who is this? This bar owner competes with Becky and wants her still sabotaged to improve his alcohol profits.
explanation: If the Chosen One manages to find out about her still, Frankie will ask them to sabotage it in hopes of getting better alcohol profits.

q: What role does Gregory have in Vault City?
explanation: Proconsul Gregory is a member of the Vault City council and Citizenship test administrator in 2241.

q: Who is this? This council member gives citizenship tests to outsiders who want to become Vault City citizens.
explanation: Gregory carries out Citizenship tests for those Outsiders who wish to join the ranks of VC Citizens.

q: What did Jack threaten to destroy in the NCR?
explanation: he wired himself to the town's power generator, threatening to blow himself and the generator to kingdom come.

q: Who is this? This NCR law officer threatens to blow up the town's generator after his marriage and life fall apart.
explanation: Jack is the assistant deputy of the NCR law in 2241.

q: What can the Chosen One do to help Joshua in Vault City?
explanation: The Chosen One can elect to save him from servitude.

q: Who is this? This outsider was taken away for resisting arrest and can leave the city with his wife and son if freed.
explanation: Once he is freed, he leaves the city with Amanda and Curtis.

q: What does Katrina do for the people of Shady Sands?
options: She guards the town's water pump
She leads the town's caravan trade
She serves as the town's guide
She runs the town's medical clinic
explanation: Katrina is a resident of Shady Sands in 2161. She serves as the town's guide.

q: Who is this? This resident of Shady Sands helps the townspeople and serves as their guide.
explanation: Katrina is a resident of Shady Sands in 2161. She serves as the town's guide.

q: What does Barkus manage in Vault City?
explanation: Barkus manages slavery in Vault City, including acquisition, assignment, and processing.

q: Who is this? This stern Vault City official manages the acquisition and assignment of servants.
explanation: A stern official holding the post of Vault City Servant Coordinator, Barkus manages slavery in Vault City, including acquisition, assignment, and processing.

q: What does Ben Wade oversee in the wastes?
options: A mine exchanging gold for medicine
Caravans trading supplies for gold ore
A settlement trading weapons for food
explanation: Ben Wade is a surprisingly brave citizen who does not hide behind laser cannons and armored guards within Vault City, but is out in the wastes, overseeing caravans to and from Redding, trading medical supplies for…

q: Who is this? This Vault City citizen goes out into the wastes to oversee caravans trading medical supplies for gold ore.
explanation: Ben Wade is a surprisingly brave citizen who does not hide behind laser cannons and armored guards within Vault City, but is out in the wastes, overseeing caravans to and from Redding, trading medical supplies for…

q: What does the flower child give the Vault Dweller in Fallout?
options: A healing potion for the journey
A flower as a symbol of the Holy Flame
explanation: The flower child will give the Vault Dweller a flower, as a symbol of the Holy Flame.

q: Who is this? This bodyguard lives in Necropolis and protects its leader.
explanation: Garret is a bodyguard of Set living in Necropolis in 2161.

q: What story does Leanne tell the Chosen One in Fallout 2?
options: A story about the Vault 13 water chip
A story about the Master and the events after his defeat
A story about Junktown's boxing matches
A story about the Hub's caravan houses
explanation: She will tell the Chosen One her story of the Master, and the events following his demise, in return for $5 for a Nuka-Cola.

q: Who is this? This Den bar patron remembers a story about a great mutant migration after the Unity's defeat.
explanation: she remembers a story about a great mutant migration in the wake of the Unity's defeat.

q: What do the Hub police officers do in Fallout?
options: Guard the water chip in Vault 13
